name: @starter/backend-cloudflare
description: The starter API on Cloudflare Workers: Hono, D1 and R2, held to contract/openapi.yaml.
author: Qaisar Khan <kaiser@kaiserkhan.com>

scripts.deploy: node scripts/predeploy.mjs && wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --remote && wrangler deploy
scripts.deploy:staging: node scripts/predeploy.mjs --config wrangler.staging.toml && wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --remote -c wrangler.staging.toml && wrangler deploy -c wrangler.staging.toml
